question: What is the total duration of a hockey match as per the International Hockey Federation rules?
solution:
The Correct Answer **60 Minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total duration of a hockey match as per the International Hockey Federation Rule is **60 Minutes.**
 
• Before 2019, matches were played for 70 minutes.
 
• NHL games consist of playtime of **60 Minutes** that breaks down into three separate periods.
 
• A regular game of Hockey consists of **three 20-minute periods, with a 15-minute intermission after the first and second periods**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Narinder Batra is the President of the International Hockey Federation (FIH).
 
• The International Hockey Federation(Ice) has **82** member national associations.
 
• Its headquarters are in **Lausanne, Switzerland**.
